mission_check.reusable_capability: Learn attacks and party switching from measured outcomes under the learner's own continuation policy.
mission_check.learned_authority: One frozen H successor experiment; no final-player promotion or teacher fallback.
mission_check.transfer_test: Unused generated full-party battles against frozen H; two independently booted natural DEVELOPMENT sources test early attack transfer only.
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: Policy-bound labels cannot improve retained TRAIN decisions, or the one successor regresses against H on the unused paired cohort.
mission_check.stop_condition: One declared collection, fit and comparison; retain failures without a successor sweep. Stop natural preparation at two bounded sources or its declared setup failure. No full game or push.

user_clarification: Demonstrated learning is required, not perfect battle wins. Fresh independent bounded test-source preparation is now authorized.

collection.selection: Per root: lowest two opening capture IDs, lowest useful replacement capture ID, lowest endgame MAIN capture ID; metadata-only, no return-based selection.
collection.continuation: Frozen H, recorded policy ID and exact model hash; no teacher continuation.
collection.target_migration: Keep teacher and learner targets separate and policy-bound; count new measurements separately from unique physical contexts. Old labels are immutable retention tests, not conflicting optimization labels for the same state.

fit.retention: Original44 move <=0.0554; retained52 move <=0.0648 and composed <=0.1609. Preserve H narrow128 move/switch/composed, new80 composed, retained52 switch, prior48 broad move/switch/composed and late90 move/switch/composed.
fit.learning_gate: At least10% lower learner-continuation composed TRAIN regret and every declared retention check passes.

paired_comparison.learning_signal: Candidate wins strictly more than H with no increase in total party faints; all episodes terminal with no invalid action or teacher fallback. Report paired win discordances and limitations, not significance or perfect-play claims.
paired_comparison.failure_handling: Keep zero improvement, regression, losses and runtime failures; no same-cohort fitting or replacement.

natural_sources.boundary: Brock battle before first decision, using existing bounded opening/errand/Pewter preparation only.
natural_sources.claim_limit: One-Pokemon sources are attack tests, not full-party switching qualification; independent boot origins and trainer IDs required.
